messages:
deploy-bot: [automated] Scheduled change window: runtime rollout v2.4 -> starts 2024-11-02 00:00 UTC, estimated 3h. Will perform stepwise canary: 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m observation pauses. Possible transient 5xx during canary. Posting status updates at start, after canary steps, and at completion. :rocket:

sara_cs: Noted. Can someone draft a short statuspage + customer email snippet I can reuse? Want a concise copy for SLAs and non-tech PMs. :slightly_smiling_face:

jenny_prod: Draft below — lightweight and copyable. Feel free to tweak.
```
Statuspage:
Summary: We are performing a stepwise runtime rollout (v2.4) that may cause brief, intermittent API errors or elevated latency during canary testing.
Start: 2024-11-02 00:00 UTC
Expected duration: ~3 hours
Impact: Short-lived 5xx or latency spikes for a small subset of requests during canary phases. Overall service should remain available.
What we’re doing: Gradual rollout with monitoring and automatic rollback conditions.
Contacts: support@redwood.ai (for customers), ops oncall in #eng-oncall
```

amanda_marketing: Nice — please add an EU/US time conversion line and a short external link to the incident FAQ. Also include a short subject line for email: "Planned runtime update — possible brief disruptions (Nov 2)"

matt_oncall: Adding rollback criteria to keep ops consistent: rollback if sustained >2% 5xx across a 5-minute window or p95 latency increases >200ms for 5 minutes post-step. Also mention fallback to pinned model variant B if rollback triggers. Keep it short. :warning:

ops_ellis: I can post the statuspage updates. Which statuspage component ID should I use? Also happy to schedule the start/complete posts.

sara_cs: Use component `runtime-api` and statuspage id sp_runtime_47. Amanda — can you provide the localized times?

amanda_marketing: EU friendly: Nov 2, 01:00 CET. US ET: Nov 1, 19:00 ET. I'll prep the email subject/body once copy is final.

jenny_prod: Finalized template with rollback & contact lines. Short customer-facing snippet: 
"On Nov 2 at 00:00 UTC we will perform a staged runtime update (v2.4). You may see brief, intermittent API errors or latency as we validate canary traffic. We monitor closely and will automatically rollback if we detect elevated errors or latency. Support is available at support@redwood.ai." :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy started: runtime-rollout-v2.4 (canary 20%) — id dpl_20241102_0000. Logging events to ops stream.

ops_ellis: Posted initial statuspage update: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/sp_runtime_47/initial - included the snippet and start time. Will post an update at canary completion.

sara_cs: Thanks all — I'll queue the customer email using jenny's final snippet and Amanda's localized times. Planning a short follow-up at end of window.

matt_oncall: I'll be watching metrics; ping me @matt_oncall if anything looks off.

ops_ellis: Canary succeeded — moved to 50% at +25m. Posted update to statuspage with note that we're progressing.

deploy-bot: Canary step complete: 50% -> proceeding to 100% after monitoring period.

ops_ellis: Rollout finished to 100%. Posted completion message and closed incident at https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/sp_runtime_47/complete. Customers will get a short completion email. :white_check_mark:

sara_cs: Great job team — final email scheduled. Closing thread once emails send.
